MiniMaxV2ContentItem.description: One input: text, image, video or audio.

type.description:
Item type.

**Allowed values:**
- `text`: Text prompt in `text`.
- `image_url`: Image in `image_url.url`.
- `video_url`: Video in `video_url.url`.
- `audio_url`: Audio in `audio_url.url`.

text.description: The prompt; required and non-empty when `type` is `text`. Up to 7000 characters for generation and Context IR, 40000 for regeneration.

image_url.description: The image; required when `type` is `image_url`. JPG / JPEG / PNG / WEBP / HEIC / HEIF, up to 30 MB, 256–5760 px per side, aspect ratio 0.4–2.5.

video_url.description: The video; required when `type` is `video_url`. MP4 / MOV (H.264 or H.265), up to 50 MB, 2–15 s per clip and 15 s in total, 23.976–60 fps.

audio_url.description: The audio; required when `type` is `audio_url`. WAV / MP3, up to 15 MB, 2–15 s per clip and 15 s in total.

role.description:
What the item is used for. A single image without a role is treated as `first_frame`; with several images every image needs a role. `video_url` requires `reference_video`, `audio_url` requires `reference_audio`, and `text` takes no role.

**Allowed values:**
- `first_frame`: First-frame image (image-to-video), at most 1.
- `last_frame`: Last-frame image, at most 1; pair with a first frame for first-and-last-frame generation.
- `reference_image`: Reference image (multimodal reference), at most 9.
- `reference_video`: Reference video (multimodal reference), at most 3.
- `reference_audio`: Reference audio (multimodal reference), at most 3.

MiniMaxV2ContextIRRequest.description: Request body of an H3 Context IR task, which analyzes the inputs and returns an enhanced structured prompt instead of a video.

model.description:
Model name. Must be `MiniMax-H3`.

**Allowed values:**
- `MiniMax-H3`: MiniMax H3 flagship model.

content.description: Input items with exactly one non-empty `text` item; media rules are the same as for video generation.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds, an integer from `4` to `15`.

ratio.description:
Aspect ratio. Required for text-to-video and cannot be `adaptive`; image-to-video always follows the input image (other values are ignored); multimodal reference defaults to `adaptive`.

**Allowed values:**
- `adaptive`: Adaptive: image-to-video follows the input image, reference-to-video is decided by the model. Not available for text-to-video.
- `21:9`: 21:9 ultra-wide.
- `16:9`: 16:9 landscape.
- `4:3`: 4:3 landscape.
- `1:1`: 1:1 square.
- `3:4`: 3:4 portrait.
- `9:16`: 9:16 portrait.

MiniMaxV2CreateTaskResponse.description: Response of a successful create call.

task_id.description: Task ID, used to query the task.

type.description:
Error category.

**Allowed values:**
- `bad_request_error`: Invalid parameters (400).
- `authorized_error`: Authentication failed (401 / 403).
- `insufficient_balance_error`: Insufficient balance (402).
- `unprocessable_entity_error`: Input contains sensitive content (422).
- `rate_limit_error`: Rate limited (429); retry later.
- `server_error`: Server error (500); retry later.
- `overloaded_error`: Overloaded (529); retry later.

message.description: Error message; the trailing number in parentheses is the error code, e.g. `(2013)`.

MiniMaxV2ErrorResponse.description: Error response. The HTTP status is the error code.

request_id.description: Request ID, equal to the `X-Request-Id` header. Include it when contacting support.

url.description: A public `http(s)` URL or a `data:<type>;base64,<data>` URL (lowercase format). `mm_file://` is not supported. The whole request body is limited to 64 MB, so use public URLs for large files.

MiniMaxV2RegenerationContentItem.description: A regeneration input; adds the `base_video` role to the regular roles.

type.description:
Item type.

**Allowed values:**
- `text`: Text prompt in `text`.
- `image_url`: Image in `image_url.url`.
- `video_url`: Video in `video_url.url`.
- `audio_url`: Audio in `audio_url.url`.

text.description: The prompt; required and non-empty when `type` is `text`. Up to 7000 characters for generation and Context IR, 40000 for regeneration.

image_url.description: The image; required when `type` is `image_url`. JPG / JPEG / PNG / WEBP / HEIC / HEIF, up to 30 MB, 256–5760 px per side, aspect ratio 0.4–2.5.

video_url.description: The video; required when `type` is `video_url`. MP4 / MOV (H.264 or H.265), up to 50 MB, 2–15 s per clip and 15 s in total, 23.976–60 fps.

audio_url.description: The audio; required when `type` is `audio_url`. WAV / MP3, up to 15 MB, 2–15 s per clip and 15 s in total.

role.description:
What the item is used for. The source video must be `base_video`; other roles work as for regular items.

**Allowed values:**
- `base_video`: The source video to regenerate; exactly 1.
- `first_frame`: First-frame image used for the source video.
- `last_frame`: Last-frame image used for the source video.
- `reference_image`: Reference image used for the source video.
- `reference_video`: Reference video used for the source video.
- `reference_audio`: Reference audio used for the source video.

status.description:
Task status.

**Allowed values:**
- `queued`: Waiting in the queue.
- `running`: In progress.
- `succeeded`: Succeeded; read the output from `content`.
- `failed`: Failed; read `error`. Not charged.
- `cancelled`: Cancelled. Not charged.

error.description: Failure reason, only when `status` is `failed` or `cancelled`. Failed and cancelled tasks are not charged.

updated_at.description: Time of the last status change, Unix seconds.

resolution.description: Output resolution; not returned for Context IR tasks.

usage.description: Usage of the task, detailed only when `status` is `succeeded` (an empty object on failure).

ratio.description: Aspect ratio; an empty string when not applicable.

task_type.description:
Task type.

**Allowed values:**
- `generation`: Video generation (`/v2/video_generation`).
- `h3_context_ir`: H3 Context IR (`/v2/h3_context_ir`).
- `regeneration`: Video regeneration (`/v2/video_regeneration`).

modality.description:
Output modality.

**Allowed values:**
- `video`: Video (generation and regeneration).
- `text`: Text (Context IR).

url.description: Video download URL (generation and regeneration tasks), e.g. `https://api.dreamto.ai/v2/files/mmxf_<32 hex characters>`. Downloading needs no API Key and supports `Range` requests. The link is valid for at most 7 days, so download and store the video promptly. Repeated queries of a task return the same link.

prompt.description: The enhanced structured prompt (Context IR tasks).

MiniMaxV2TaskResponse.description: Query response when `response_format` is `task`. With `flat`, the fields of `task` are at the top level instead.

MiniMaxV2TaskUsage.description: Task usage. Video tasks report seconds; Context IR tasks report tokens.

input_image_count.description: Number of input images (first frame + last frame + reference images).

input_audio_seconds.description: Seconds of reference audio input; omitted without reference audio.

prompt_tokens.description: Input tokens (for video tasks, the inputs converted to tokens).

completion_tokens.description: Output tokens (for video tasks, the output video converted to tokens).

MiniMaxV2VideoGenerationRequest.description: Request body of a video generation task.

model.description:
Model name. Must be `MiniMax-H3`.

**Allowed values:**
- `MiniMax-H3`: MiniMax H3 flagship model.

content.description: Input items. Must include a non-empty `text` item (the prompt); images, videos and audio are told apart by `role`. Frame roles (`first_frame` / `last_frame`) cannot be combined with reference roles (`reference_image` / `reference_video` / `reference_audio`).

duration.description: Video duration in seconds, an integer from `4` to `15`.

ratio.description:
Aspect ratio. Required for text-to-video and cannot be `adaptive`; image-to-video always follows the input image (other values are ignored); multimodal reference defaults to `adaptive`.

**Allowed values:**
- `adaptive`: Adaptive: image-to-video follows the input image, reference-to-video is decided by the model. Not available for text-to-video.
- `21:9`: 21:9 ultra-wide.
- `16:9`: 16:9 landscape.
- `4:3`: 4:3 landscape.
- `1:1`: 1:1 square.
- `3:4`: 3:4 portrait.
- `9:16`: 9:16 portrait.

aigc_watermark.description: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video. Defaults to `false`.

response_format.description:
Shape of the query response for this task. Defaults to `task`.

**Allowed values:**
- `task`: Task fields are nested under `task`.
- `flat`: Task fields are at the top level.

MiniMaxV2VideoRegenerationRequest.description: Request body of a regeneration task, which regenerates a video matching the MiniMax-H3 768P output spec as 2K. Provide exactly one of `source_task_id` and `content`.

model.description:
Model name. Must be `MiniMax-H3`.

**Allowed values:**
- `MiniMax-H3`: MiniMax H3 flagship model.

source_task_id.description: Regenerate by task: the `task_id` of a `succeeded` `/v2/video_generation` task of your account created within the last 7 days. Do not combine with `content`.

content.description: Regenerate from a source video: exactly one `video_url` with `role` `base_video`, plus the final prompt and all inputs used to generate that video, unchanged. The source needs an audio track, 24 fps, sides divisible by 32, 768×768 to 768×1344 pixels and 107–362 frames. Do not combine with `source_task_id`.

aigc_watermark.description: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video. Defaults to `false`.

bearerAuth.description: Send your DreamTo API Key in the `Authorization: Bearer <API Key>` header.

info.description: Same paths, request bodies, responses and error envelope as the official MiniMax V2 video API (`/v2/video_generation`, `/v2/video_regeneration`, `/v2/h3_context_ir`, `/v2/query/video_generation/{task_id}`). To migrate from MiniMax, change the base URL to `https://api.dreamto.ai` and use a DreamTo API Key.
